name: Redeem pasted ecash with no internet connection, then recover
description: With no internet connection, pasted ecash shows up as pending and tapping Redeem cannot finish while the mint is unreachable. Once the connection returns, tapping Redeem again completes it and the money is credited (9 sats after the throwaway test mint's 1-sat fee).
details: On the Android emulator, pre-trust testnut by adding it via the mint UI online, then go into REAL airplane mode and paste a single testnut token: the receive sheet shows +B10 RECEIVE·PENDING 'Tap Redeem to add to wallet' under the offline banner, and tapping Redeem cannot complete the swap while the mint is unreachable. Proven product FINDING (live 2026-07-19): the offline redeem is NOT persisted as a pending transaction — relaunching loses it entirely (wallet returns to No History, B0). So the recovery is a MANUAL re-redeem while still on the sheet: reconnect, tap Redeem again, the swap completes and the wallet credits +10 face value (net +9 after the 1-sat testnut redeem fee). Proves the offline-receive flow + recovery end-to-end with real device offline. testnut is valueless (auto write-off, no sweep). First Android exercise of the e2e clipboard bridge feeding the app's real Paste + the funded runtime (seed export over adb reverse, cocod counterparty). The single counterparty fund equals maxPrincipal (funded-runtime invariant); pre-trust is a UI add, not a fund. Allow-Paste taps are optional (Android has no blocking paste dialog, unlike iOS)
